recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-35979; future DeviceUsage conformance changes should be evaluated in HL7/oo-incubator, where the current continuous build already permits Procedure for DeviceUsage.reason.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO change request raised against R4 DeviceUseStatement because the example used Procedure in reasonReference while the element target list did not support Procedure. The approved R5 resolution was to make that compatible enhancement.
initial_application: Jira identifies commit 7c2cdfbd00b94deadf011e6f9dc92826408c0ac2 as the build application. Inspecting the merge parent diff shows it added Procedure as a targetProfile on DeviceUsage.reason in source/deviceusage/structuredefinition-DeviceUsage.xml.
additional_context: OO WGM minutes for 2022-05-09 record that DeviceUseStatement had been renamed to DeviceUsage and approve adding Procedure as an allowed referenced resource. In the current core source, DeviceUsage is absent from the active source/fhir.ini [resources] list and core narrative links DeviceUsage to the HL7 OO incubator IG. The retained out-of-build core source and the current OO incubator StructureDefinition both include Procedure for DeviceUsage.reason.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with no core source changes because the requested semantic fix was already applied and the relevant current artifact is outside the active FHIR core build.
